hero._sprite_note: Start tier 01/01 = bare body + wooden sword: what a new player has on Stage 1 in both clips (c1 0:00, c2 1:50); tiers rise with the stage-prep sword/helmet upgrades (not built). Override with ?tier=06 or ?armor=06&sword=06. Sprite is mirrored around pivotX (measured: clip c1 frame left x 188 facing right, 166 facing left). weaponOffset = where the original draws the weapon layer relative to the body in slash frames, per armor tier, measured on clip c1 0:51-0:52 (tier 01 only; other tiers line up at the same origin and are unmeasured). lunge 0: the body does not move on a slash in the clip.
hero._damage_note: slash damage = max(1, 4*ATK - 2*DEF + (ATK >= 3 ? (rand() % ATK) / 4 : 1)) (Scene_UI::FUC_CALCULATE_DAMAGE @0x607ee0, from Scene_Stage::update @0x59273c with player ATK +0x53c); x2 "PERFECT" when rand()%100 < player+0x560 = GameData+0x9618[knight] = 1 (@0x592744; FUC_INIT_PLAYER @0x5f1cdc). Monster -> knight uses the same formula with monster ATK vs knight DEF (FUC_HIT_BY_MONSTER @0x5b9dd4).

dash._src: red button = the knight class skill (Scene_Stage::Call_Back_Ready_To_Skill -> FUC_SKILL_START @0x5be038, EFF_DASH): the knight dashes along the facing side and every monster his collision box meets takes FUC_CALCULATE_DAMAGE(skill power = player+0x540 = knightStats.skillByWeaponLevel, monster DEF) (Scene_Stage::update @0x591a28: while dashing, each frame the knight sprite box is tested against every monster hit box; a monster is hit once (Monster+0x5cc set, cleared again in FUC_MONSTER_ATTACK); the web hits every monster on the facing side, the dash path itself is a web value). Re-armed by SCH_CHECK_MISSION_TARGET_TIME @0x58c018 counting a timer down 0.1 per 0.1 s tick; the timer max (+0xcb4) is written by a store this pass could not find, so cooldown 10.0 s is CLIP-MEASURED (ring refill c1 7:30.5 -> 7:40, 2 fps).

swordStorm._src: blue button = Sword Storm (Call_Back_Ready_To_Sword_Storm). Uses come only from prep boosters (no in-stage gain: the clip shows 0 through stages 1-4 with 40+ kills); the booster row is locked in this build, so it stays 0.
swordStorm._damage: per sword: FUC_CALCULATE_DAMAGE(ceil(ATK/2) + trunc(ceil(ATK/2) * GameData+0x9480 * 0.01), DEF), GameData+0x9480 = 0 at start (Guardian_Bullet type 4, SCH_CREATE_STORM_SWORD @0x58c39c); swords spawn every 0.08 s (Scene_Stage::init schedule @0x575b10) on 13 angles 90..-90 deg, each with a 50% roll, while a timer > 0 counts down 0.24 per tick. The timer start value was not found, so the web keeps damage 99 to every monster on screen: PLACEHOLDER (booster-only, 0 charges in this build)
